title: Open Contracts predicate expression
description: A predicate is a single string expression. Field paths are relative to the complete input JSON value; no fixed root property is reserved.
$comment: Readable grammar: expression := or-expression; or-expression := and-expression (OR and-expression)*; and-expression := not-expression (AND not-expression)*; not-expression := NOT not-expression | comparison; comparison := primary (comparison-operator primary)?; primary := field-reference | JSON-scalar | TRUE | FALSE | NULL | exists-call | '(' expression ')'; field-reference is a chain of .name segments and [JSON-string] selectors. Numeric segments such as .items.0 address array indexes and numeric object keys. Use a bracketed JSON string for object keys containing dots, slashes, or other punctuation. JSON Schema validates the string wire type; the evaluator validates grammar and semantics.
